title: Structured Logging Plan
description: A structured plan for a service's production logging design, so this skill's anti-patterns and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/structured_logging_audit.mjs.

format.description: The production log line format. Must be json to pass.

dataInMessageString.description: True if any values are interpolated into the message string instead of living in named fields.

piiRedactorAtLoggerLevel.description: True if a single redactor runs over every log line at the logger level, keyed by field name.

traceIdBound.description: True if request-scoped logs carry a trace_id bound via middleware/contextvars, W3C traceparent-compatible.

fieldNameConvention.description: The field-name convention actually in force across the service's logs.

highCardinalityFieldsNormalized.description: True if high-cardinality values (raw IDs in paths, error messages with embedded UUIDs) are normalized to templates before indexing.

errorLogSites.description: Where exceptions get logged: one top-level handler, or at every layer they pass through.

asyncLogger.description: True if the logger is asynchronous with a drop-on-overflow buffer, so a slow destination never blocks requests.

longFieldsCapped.description: True if long fields (request/response bodies) are truncated to ~1KB outside debug level.

coldStorageTier.description: True if a cheap cold-storage tier (e.g. S3 + Athena) holds long-retention logs separately from the hot search vendor.
